about: Manual overrides for scripts/build-universe.mjs. ids: CoinGecko coin to use for an exchange symbol when the largest-market-cap coin with that symbol is a different asset; also: other exchange symbols for the same coin (their listings count, and they are not matched separately). keep: coins that a CoinGecko stablecoin/security category would drop but that are not themselves stablecoins or securities. exclude: coins to drop that no category catches. add: coins that none of the three exchanges lists but that belong in the screener; looked up by CoinGecko id and kept through every refresh (they show without an exchange). ko: Korean names by exchange symbol, used before Upbit's and Bithumb's (for coins they do not name, or to correct a name).

FRAX.reason: Binance and Bithumb FRAX is the Frax governance token (formerly FXS, about $0.29), not the Legacy Frax Dollar stablecoin that shares the symbol

PRL.reason: Upbit and Bithumb PRL is Perle, not Pearl

EDGE.reason: Upbit and Bithumb EDGE is Definitive; edgeX trades as EDGEX

EDGEX.reason: Bithumb EDGEX is edgeX (CoinGecko symbol EDGE)

META.reason: Upbit and Bithumb META is Metadium; MetaDAO trades as META2

META2.reason: Upbit and Bithumb META2 is MetaDAO (CoinGecko symbol META)

AI.reason: Upbit and Bithumb AI and Binance AIGENSYN are Gensyn, not Artificial Inu (Binance's own AI pair is Sleepless AI, too small to rank)

ONE.reason: Binance ONE is Harmony, not ONEchain

MEME.reason: Binance MEME is Memecoin (Memeland), not MEMETOON

UP.reason: Bithumb UP and Upbit UP2 are Superform, not Unitas

XAI.reason: Binance and Bithumb XAI is Xai, not SideShift

TREE.reason: Upbit, Bithumb and Binance TREE is Treehouse, not Tree

REI.reason: Upbit, Bithumb and Binance REI is REI Network (about $0.002, matching the exchange prices), not Rei (unit-00-rei)

AXL.reason: Upbit and Binance AXL and Bithumb WAXL are Axelar

MET.reason: Bithumb and Binance MET and Upbit MET2 are Meteora

BTT.reason: Upbit and Bithumb BTT and Binance BTTC are BitTorrent (the new BTT)

BEAM.reason: Upbit and Bithumb BEAM and Binance BEAMX are Beam

RON.reason: Bithumb RON and Binance RONIN are Ronin

keep.EL: ELYSIA is the governance and staking token of a real-estate tokenization platform; it is not a share in any property (CoinGecko lists it under Tokenized Real Estate for the platform)

XMR.reason: Not on Upbit, Bithumb or Binance spot (Binance delisted it on 2024-02-20; its pairs remain in BREAK status), so the listing rule leaves it out; added at the owner's request (2026-10-19)

KAS.reason: Not on Upbit, Bithumb or Binance spot, so the listing rule leaves it out; added at the owner's request (2026-10-19)
